_provenance: Stop sequence for test_trailing_stop_cannot_decrease_tick_to_tick_live_consumer. Simulates a live-consumer tick sequence where current_return rises to 2.5% (advancing the stop to 2.0), then retraces to 2.0% (naive math would lower stop to 1.0). The ratchet must retain 2.0. symphony_vol=1.0 throughout; 5 pre-lock ticks (current_return=1.5, base_stop=-1.0) followed by the post-lock retrace. Tick values derived by hand: with symphony_vol=1.0, dynamic_activation=clamp(1.0, 0.4, 3.0)=1.0, qualifying_threshold=1.0-0.2=0.8. current_return=1.5 > 0.8 so each pre-lock tick qualifies. Lock fires after 5 consecutive qualifying ticks (HWM_HOLD_TICKS_THRESHOLD=5). Post-lock base_stop_levels: 2.0 (tick 6), then 1.0 (tick 7 — retrace). Naive max(1.0, 0.0)=1.0 < 2.0 is the violation. Ratcheted result must be max(2.0, max(1.0,0.0))=2.0.
description: 7-tick position lifetime: 5 pre-lock ticks locking breakeven, then stop advances to 2.0, then retraces to base 1.0. Ratchet must hold 2.0.
